name: Borys Budka - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the renewal of the Agreement on cooperation in science and technology between the European Community and Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that the European Union should renew its science and technology cooperation agreement with Ukraine for another five years. The agreement already exists and has been renewed four times before. Renewing it keeps the current rules in place and adds no new rights or obligations for either side. It lets scientists and researchers in the EU and Ukraine keep working together on shared priorities such as new materials, information technology, physics, energy and biotechnology.

- The existing science and technology agreement with Ukraine is extended for five more years, with no changes to its content.
- It affects researchers and scientists in the EU and Ukraine who work together on shared projects.
- The Council can now finalise the renewal, so the agreement continues without a gap.
